claim: Projections, not just the router. Lossless 12-bit BF16 weights (sign+mantissa plus a 3-bit exponent delta) cut the HBM traffic that already sits on the 4.8 TB/s floor, and a prepare-time cuBLASLt search covers m=128/256. The router above 32 tokens is one GEMM on the concatenated hi+lo matrix. This is the public Apache-2.0 v20 design that scored 1.4155x on okc check (board about 3410 us). Measure it here, then attack whatever is still short of 1.51x.
reject_if: ci_high < 1.20 against the same-run SGLang baseline
